type.description: A stable key the app words. Known now: admin_sign_in, sign_in_refused, second_factor_failed, second_factor_locked, rate_limited, blocked. Later milestones add more (sign_up, share, report, payment_failed...), so the app shows an unknown key as a generic event.

ip.description: The raw address, for 30 days; null after.

ipHash.description: The first 12 characters of the address's HMAC, to link events across accounts.

context.description: Values for the type: limiter and rule, reason, where, attempts, method.
